articles.title: Creator of Viral Needle in a Haystack Game Roasts Copycats With 'Find the Original Game' Mode
articles.summary: The creator of a viral indie game where players must literally find a needle in a haystack is tired of his project getting cloned. So, he made a new game mode, where players must find the real game in a pile of fakes.
body: Thanks to advancements in artificial intelligence, it’s getting easier and easier for players to 'reverse-engineer' video games and even outright copy projects that haven’t been released yet.

It’s been a hellish situation for developers in the industry, particularly for small studios without the funds for legal backing or, even worse, single creators who made their games all by themselves.

NasNakarus is the driving mind behind Needle in a Haystack Simulator, which is exactly what it sounds like. Such a simple concept is easy to copy, and there are currently oodles of similar titles clogging online marketplaces. But he’s not taking it personally; instead, he’s poking fun at the ordeal with some well-timed commentary and a new ‘mode’ for his game.
points: The creator of a viral indie game where players must literally find a needle in a haystack is tired of his project getting cloned.
So, he made a new game mode, where players must find the real game in a pile of fakes.

articles.title: Kane Parsons Says He Is Working on Three 'Dream Projects,' Leading to Speculation Over Valve Collaboration
articles.summary: Backrooms director Kane Parsons says he is working on three different "dream projects," which has caused no end of speculation regarding a possible collaboration with Valve.
body: When speaking on The Kyle Buchanan Show, Parsons confirmed he has three "dream projects" currently in the works, all while wearing a Valve hoodie. The young director has made no secret of his love for Valve, particularly Portal and Half-Life.

Earlier this year, Parsons made his big-screen debut with Backrooms, a film adaptation/expansion of his highly popular web horror series. Ever since then, he's been a hot commodity in Hollywood. The filmmaker expressed interest in making a Portal movie around the time of Backrooms' release, which excited fans.

Following the release of his debut film, Parsons visited Valve's office, which has led some to believe that he's been actively meeting with the developer to bring their IP to life. This wouldn't be the first try at adapting Valve's franchises, as J.J. Abrams was attempting to bring Half-Life and Portal to the big screen. Abrams said in 2021 that he was still developing Portal, and that a script was being actively worked on. However, no one has heard anything since then.

articles.title: You Can Make Your WoW: Forever Character Now And Be Ready For Launch
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's character creation and name reservations are now live, letting you save some time on launch day by making your characters now rather than on launch day.
body: To access name reservations, you'll need to have Forever preinstalled on Battle.net and have purchased at least the $30 Skyborne Heroic Pack, which grants access to the game's new optional playable race, the Skyborne elves. Once you've done that, you can simply log into the game, select the ruleset you want to play on, and create your characters.

You can create and name up to three characters ahead of launch day. Unlike in other versions of developer Blizzard's MMORPG, Forever requires both a first name and last name for characters, giving you more options and creative freedom when it comes to names.

When making a character, make sure you create them on the server ruleset you intend to play on. Once the game is live, Blizzard said there won't be a way to transfer characters to different rulesets. It's also worth noting that on player vs. player rulesets, you will only be able to create characters of a single faction on that specific ruleset, so make your choice of Alliance or Horde wisely.

articles.title: Resident Evil Executive Producer Says the Series' Story Could End 'In the Next 10 Years'
articles.summary: In an interview with Yahoo Japan, executive producer Jun Takeuchi outlined Capcom’s plans for its flagship horror franchise, revealing that its encompassing narrative has a definite conclusion — and that end could come shockingly soon.
body: Takeuchi began by explaining how the team had expanded on Resident Evil’s overarching story with every game, saying that a ten-year strategy was crafted during the planning stages for Resident Evil 2 Remake.

“The series' story wasn't planned out from the beginning; it expanded with each new game. When we were planning RE:2 and creating a 10-year branding concept, this was the most challenging aspect. If you play through all of them, I think you'll realize the meaning behind the order of the remakes,” he said.
“With the release of Requiem this year, I feel like the first 10 years have come to a close, so I think the conclusion will come in the next 10 years."

This is somewhat sad news for hardcore fans who were hoping to blast through hordes of zombies with Leon until the end of time, not to mention fans of all the other characters we’ve come to know and love over the years. And who’s to say if that means we won’t see these characters again in a new, different story?

articles.title: This TSA-Compliant Daran 89.6Wh 100W LiFePO4 Power Station Drops to Just $49.99
articles.summary: Ahead of Black Friday, Amazon is offering the diminutive Daran 89.6Wh 100W Power Station for just $49.99 after applying coupon code " DDDD4999 ". Unlike previous iterations of this deal, you don't to be an Amazon Prime member to be eligible.
body: The Daran power station just 6.5" x 3.3" x 4" and weighs in at a portable 2.5 pounds. The 89.6W battery capacity (approximately 28,000mAh at 3.2V) is also TSA compliant, so you can bring it with you on your airplane flights.

It has a total of seven charging ports, including two 120V AC outlets (100W max), two USB-C ports (45W/15W), two USB-A ports (18W/15W), and a DC5521 port (60W). The 100W max output on the AC outlet is good for charging higher powered mobile electronics like your laptop, iPad, or handheld gaming PC, but it's also handy for older, legacy electronics that are powered by a traditional plug and not a USB cable.

The power station uses LiFePO4 cells instead of NCM cells you'd find in some other budget power stations. LiFePO4 cells have inherently safer chemistry, longer lifespan, and slower calendar aging than NCM cells. They are widely regarded as the best battery option for power stations.

articles.title: GTA 6 Developers Are About To Do Something Historic
articles.summary: Workers at GTA 6 developer Rockstar will soon get to vote on recognizing a union. The union, IWGB Union at Rockstar, is for Rockstar's UK-based developers. Rockstar North, based in Edinburgh, Scotland, is one of Rockstar's biggest outfits in the UK, and the lead developer on GTA 6.
body: The negotiating process between the union and Rockstar management took months, and the union, if recognized, would give workers a stronger seat at the table for key issues like pay and bonuses, overtime, generative AI policies, work-from-home setups, and situations involving layoffs.
The IWGB Rockstar Game Workers Union would become the largest in the UK video game sector, if it's voted in.
The voting period--November 12-26--overlaps with the release of GTA 6 on November 19.

At the same time, an employment tribunal over claims that Rockstar fired developers for trying to form a union is coming to a close, with final arguments set for November 17 and November 18. More than 30 IWGB members were let go from Rockstar in the UK in October 2025, with the union saying Rockstar fired them for trying to form a union. Rockstar, for its part, said the staffers were dismissed for leaking key details about Rockstar's upcoming games.
points: Workers at GTA 6 developer Rockstar will soon get to vote on recognizing a union.

articles.title: The Lord of the Rings: Return of the King Is Officially Getting a New Version Next Year
articles.summary: There have been an enormous number of tabletop adaptations of J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Lord of the Rings, but few capture the story so well and in such an accessible fashion as Bryan Bornmueller’s The Lord of the Rings Trick-Taking Game.
body: “My proudest achievement with this game is I had multiple playtest groups tell me that they teared up a little bit when they played the last chapter, especially people who have played for a few years together,” Bornmueller told Polygon in an interview at Spiel Essen.

Bornmueller’s a lifelong fan of the series. His dad read him The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings when he was young, and the comic book store he worked at while attending Iowa State University organized midnight showings of Peter Jackson’s films. When Reiner Knizia’s The Lord of the Rings game was released in 2000, Bornmueller stayed up all night trying to save Middle-earth. After graduation, he went to work at board game publisher Asmodee, starting as a senior sales associate and rising to the role of innovation and sourcing director, where he works with studios to develop new board and card games.

articles.title: Official WoW: Forever AMV Will Get You Super Hyped
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is almost here, and in case players weren't already excited to return to classic Azeroth, a new animated music video highlighting the war between the Horde and the Alliance is sure to get your inner player vs. player hyped up to spill some blood for your faction.
body: Called "Warpath," the animated trailer made in collaboration between developer Blizzard and Brunch Studio features a banger of a track performed by YouTuber turned musician Poppy, Amy Lee of Evanescence fame, and Courtney LaPlante, the lead singer of Canadian metal band Spiritbox. The name of the song itself is "End of You," and its nu-metal vibes go a long way to invoke the early 2000s era that WoW originally spawned from.

The trailer shows members of the Horde (an orc Rogue, tauren Hunter, undead Paladin, troll Mage) and the Alliance (a human Warrior, gnome Warlock, dwarf Shaman, night elf Priest, and Skyborne Druid) duking it out on the slopes of Mount Hyjal, one of Forever's new zones.

Each class is wearing their iconic endgame dungeon armor set and can be seen wielding more than a few recognizable weapons, like Unstoppable Force, Dal'Rend's Sacred Charge and Tribal Guardian, and others.

It's not the first time Blizzard has collaborated with Brunch on an AMV. Blizzard released "A Place To Call Home" performed by Aurora earlier this year ahead of the release of modern WoW's Midnight expansion, and it was quite the walk down memory lane for longtime players.

articles.title: Magic Is Reprinting a $20 Commander Powerhouse as a Star Trek Fan Favorite
articles.summary: Magic: The Gathering ’s Star Trek crossover set is only weeks away, and on Tuesday, Wizards of the Coast revealed five new Star Trek Secret Lair Drops featuring reprints inspired by everything from The Wrath of Khan to run-of-the-mill Klingon warriors. A sixth Drop will be revealed later.
body: The standout, at least for Commander players, is a new Thrasios, Triton Hero, which costs around $20 in its other printings. For the Lower Decks Drop, Thrasios has been reimagined as “Tendi, Exploring the Future,” with art of the enthusiastic Starfleet officer hugging her genetically engineered pet, The Dog. Tendi biologically engineered The Dog in Lower Decks season 1. Though it looks like a normal canine, The Dog can shapeshift, spit lightning, talk, and walk on walls. The flavor text reads, “I did it! I updated the dog!” which is a direct line from Lower Decks.

A green-blue (Simic) legendary merfolk wizard, Thrasios costs one green and one blue mana for a 1/3 creature. Thrasios has a four-cost ability that lets you scry 1, reveal the top card of your library, and then play that card if it’s a land or draw it if it’s not. That makes for a cheap ramp engine that can be fairly explosive in landfall decks, but because it’s not a tap ability, that means you can use the ability as many times as you want as long as you have mana available in multiples of four.

articles.title: McDonald's New 'Pokémon' Happy Meal Surprise Leaks Ahead Of Launch
articles.summary: Fast food chain McDonald's is expected to announce a new partnership with Pokémon in the coming weeks, and the worldwide promo will mark the return of a Happy Meal essential that's been missing in action for (shockingly!) eight years.
body: Pokémon and McDonald's have been teaming up on a nearly yearly basis since 2011, often with Happy Meal boxes that contain a small selection of trading card reprints. The campaigns transform the special order's packaging into a giant chipper Pikachu head, making it one of the more striking McDonald's marketing campaigns in recent memory. The initiative has proven particularly popular in recent years following the resurgence of the Pokémon trading card game — and a FOMO-driven culture that convinced fans the exclusive cards could make a worthwhile long-term investment.

These aspects of the promo are expected to return in 2026, but according to TCG site PokéBeach, that's not all of what's coming down the pike. The news site shared images of the unannounced Pokémon Happy Meal-exclusive toys debuting this year, and each one depicts a fan-favorite monster. The toys are meant to look like mini Happy Meals, but they can also double as portable frames for the cards packaged in the meal.

articles.title: Rockstar will hold union vote right on top of Grand Theft Auto 6 release
articles.summary: Rockstar employees will hold a vote on union recognition over a two-week span in November that will perfectly bracket the studio's launch of the console version of Grand Theft Auto 6.
body: The terms of the recognition deal have been under negotiation between the union and Rockstar management since July, but unionization efforts have been underway for much longer. The process came under intense scrutiny in October 2025 when the studio fired 31 employees in what the IWGB claimed was "the most brazen act of union busting the games industry has ever seen." Rockstar alleged that the fired employees were leaking GTA 6 information in a public Discord; the matter is now before an employment tribunal in Scotland.

"This November, we have the chance to make gaming history not once but twice. As all our hard work, skill and creativity are experienced by GTA VI players for the first time, our voices will now be heard for the first time too," Rockstar Game Workers Union committee member Shanti Easton-Steel said.

The one-mana 12/12 artifact creature has gone from an oddball relic of early Magic design to one of the defining threats of…
body: Mirage, Magic ’s ninth expansion, introduced a wealth of memorable cards, mechanics, and characters, including the first appearances of iconic time wizard Teferi and the verdant jungle continent of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria. Plenty of its cards remain desirable — and valuable — pieces of vintage cardboard three decades later. But few have become quite as emblematic of how old Magic can find new life as Phyrexian Dreadnought, a card whose absurd stats, tortured rules history, distinctive Pete Venters artwork, and interactions with other cards transformed it into something far more important than its designers could have ever anticipated.

articles.title: Messages in certain large public Discord servers will be searchable on the web after December
articles.summary: What once would've been a forum or wiki is often now a Discord server, and that's created a problem: valuable information is hidden away deep in the chat logs of big public Discord channels, rather than in easy-to-search forum pages on the web.
body: Discord now aims to solve that problem by making discussions in some of its biggest public servers searchable on the web.

The change will only apply to "Discoverable Servers," which refers to certain large public Discord servers with 1,000 or more users. The admins of those specially-designated servers will be able to opt out of search engine discoverability, and individual users can also opt out of allowing their messages in those servers to be searchable on the web. The change does not affect any invite-only servers or DMs.

"Prior to Discord's launch, message boards were common, ranging from community-driven forums to official ones run by game studios," reads a blog post from Discord. "These message boards excelled at hosting long-form, structured conversations about helping people, theory crafting, and more. While they still exist today, many have moved into Discord servers. This has led to valuable information being locked in Discord conversations, inaccessible to the wider internet. We want to fix this."

articles.title: "This is a serious incident" - Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse suffers cyberattack
articles.summary: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios has confirmed it's suffered a "serious" cyberattack, saying it is currently working to determine the "full extent" of its impact.
body: "To our players and friends," a statement by the studio read. "We're sorry to share that Warhorse Studios has been hit by a cyberattack. We're working with cybersecurity specialists to secure our systems and understand the full extent of what happened. Thank you for standing with us." The message was released at 11am GMT and there hasn't been an update from the studio since. We've separately asked the studio if there have been any developments.

Warhorse CEO Martin Frývaldský discussed the incident in a Czech report (translated by DeepL), saying, "This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and for everyone affected. Our immediate priority is to secure our systems, determine the full extent of the breach, and take all necessary steps to protect our employees, partners, and our community. We are devoting all necessary resources and capabilities to resolving this situation."

body: An all-action campaign full of twists and turns, MW4's single-player shines, but the multiplayer portion of Modern Warfare 4 is quite a bit duller. Solid foundations and a novel new arena ensure there’s plenty of fun to be had, but the majority of its new modes and maps do little to excite due to some unimaginative design choices and awkward spawn positions. The combination of these two halves is a much-needed reminder of what Call of Duty can be at its best, even if it can’t fully recapture the heights of its glory days.

videos.summary: Check out the latest trailer for ARC Raiders to see what to expect from Update 2.3.0, which introduces the Soul's Offering Player Project and the new Noxious set for the third-person extraction shooter game. Update 2.3.0 for ARC Raiders is now live.
body: From the trailer's official description:
"While the four contradas of Toledo can’t agree on much, one thing they all have in common are the losses they’ve suffered Topside.
As brutal stories from Pendola Pass trickle into the cantinas, Celeste is encouraging members of Speranza to honor the fallen for who they were and the dents they made in ARC’s onslaught.
points: Check out the latest trailer for ARC Raiders to see what to expect from Update 2.3.0, which introduces the Soul's Offering Player Project and the new Noxious set for the third-person extraction…
"While the four contradas of Toledo can’t agree on much, one thing they all have in common are the losses they’ve suffered Topside.
As brutal stories from Pendola Pass trickle into the cantinas, Celeste is encouraging members of Speranza to honor the fallen for who they were and the dents they made in ARC’s onslaught.
While each tribute is unique, every Raider who pauses in reverence shares in the Souls Offering.
